## Activity

During October 2022, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 361 captures. This represents the activity submitted for the reporting month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issue is noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the 361 captures, 24 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.6 per cent. These images could not proceed through the usual grading process, and the result is reported separately from the grading outcome. The rate provides a summary measure of image quality for the month.

## Grading

There were 85 referable results during October 2022. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates the typical interval associated with grading activity during the reporting period. Together, the referable count and median lag summarise the clinical grading workload and the timeliness of review at Harbour Eye Clinic.
